newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-WARNE IN GOOD FORM BEFORE FOURTH TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WARNE IN GOOD FORM BEFORE FOURTH TEST.

text.p: Leg spinner Shane Warne showed sharp form as Australia warmed up for this week's fourth test against England with a draw against Middlesex on Monday.
Warne bowled out Middlesex openers Paul Weekes and Jason Pooley with his second and seventh deliveries on his way to figures of three wickets for 55.

Middlesex needed a steady innings of 47 from former England captain Mike Gatting, now a national team selector, to finish the day on 201 for six in their second innings. Gatting eventually departed lbw to Steve Waugh.
Earlier Warne had struck 39 in Australia's first innings before captain Mark Taylor declined the chance of any further batting practice and declared at 432 for seven.
The fourth test starts at Headingley, Leeds on Thursday with the series at 1-1.
